definition: Open protocol, hosted by the Linux Foundation, for agents to discover each other through Agent Cards and collaborate over HTTP. Requests and responses use JSON-RPC 2.0.
JSON document in A2A that lists an agent's identity, capabilities, endpoint, skills, and authentication requirements so a client can decide how to call it.
An identity created for an agent so access policy, risk checks, and audit logs can apply to it. Microsoft Entra Agent ID creates these identities from blueprints.

source.title: Overview of agent identities in Microsoft Entra

definition: Signed credential in AP2. A checkout mandate records the cart negotiated with the merchant. A payment mandate authorizes a payment instrument against that checkout.
A market where an agent can hire a specialized agent for a task and pay for the work, or list its own service for other agents to hire.
A wallet an agent can use to discover paid services and pay under a cap the operator set. Tempo Wallet lets an agent preview Machine Payments Protocol terms and pay under a max spend cap.
A checkout an agent runs at a merchant for a user, with a cap set before payment. Crossmint Agent Checkouts sends a start URL, a task, and that cap, and the agent does not hold the card number.

Open standard for an agent to browse a catalog, run a checkout session, pass a delegated payment, and delegate authentication with OAuth 2.0. Stripe documents it as created by Stripe, OpenAI, and Meta.

source.title: Stripe documentation for the Agentic Commerce Protocol

definition: Open stack, hosted by the Linux Foundation, for cross vendor agent discovery, identity, messaging, and observability.
Open payment extension for A2A and the Universal Commerce Protocol. It records checkout and payment authorization as signed mandates. Public samples exist while FIDO continues the standards work.
A market where independent providers offer compute for workloads. Akash Network documents providers bidding to host those workloads.

A futures contract quoted in dollars per GPU hour. AX lists dated H100, H200, B200, and B300 contracts on its public instrument list. ICE has published monthly cash settled specifications on the Ornn Compute Price Index and says no listing date is set.

A record identified by a hash of its bytes, so a reader can check that those bytes match the identifier. Merkle proofs show membership in a larger hashed set. IPFS content identifiers are a common form. Accords is one listing that uses this for a transaction record, not the only use.
A URI that associates a subject with a DID document. The controller can prove control without permission from a centralized registry, identity provider, or certificate authority.
Work product of an open network where independent subnets produce digital commodities and the chain pays contributors.
Draft Ethereum proposal for three registries: an ERC-721 identity that points at an agent registration file, a reputation registry, and a validation registry.
Programmable check that can block, alter, or validate user input, model output, or a tool call. NeMo Guardrails runs these checks as rails around an LLM application.
HTTP status code 402, Payment Required. RFC 9110 reserves the code for future use. x402, L402, and the Machine Payments Protocol use a 402 response as the signal that the request needs payment.
A pause where a person inspects or changes agent state before the run continues. LangGraph provides this inside the graph.
Stateless remote procedure call protocol. A request is a JSON object naming a method, with optional parameters and an id, and the server returns a JSON result or error.
Know Your Agent is the check a merchant or service runs before it lets an agent transact. The check asks which agent is acting, on whose behalf, and with what authority.

comparison.name: Beltic KYA
comparison.verified: The agent, the operator who sent it, and whether the action is authorized.
comparison.how: Beltic's site says each agent gets an identity, the request carries the operator and origin, and Beltic keeps a signed record of who acted. Its SDK verifies RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures and validates agent credentials.
comparison.issuer: Beltic, which its 2026-09-30 release says verifies the agent.

comparison.name: Concordium Agent Registry
comparison.verified: That the agent is active in the registry, owned by a Concordium account, and that its Agent Card bytes match the on-chain SHA-256 hash. Concordium's ID layer links that owner to a verified person.
comparison.how: CIS-8004 mints each agent as a token that points at an Agent Card. The card is also an ERC-8004 registration file and an A2A v1.0 Agent Card. CIS-8 can bind an external key. Concordium's 2026-10-20 post says x402 payments now settle on the network.
comparison.issuer: The owner registers the agent. Concordium documents mainnet registry contract 10082.

comparison.name: ERC-8004
comparison.verified: An on-chain agent identifier, feedback about that agent, and a validation result. Payments are out of scope.
comparison.how: An ERC-721 identity registry assigns the agent id and points at a registration file. Separate registries store feedback and validation results.
comparison.issuer: Whoever deploys the registry. The ERC-721 owner controls the agent record.

comparison.name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
comparison.verified: The agent identity in a tenant, so access policy, risk checks, and audit logs can apply to it.
comparison.how: The tenant creates agent identities from blueprints. Authentication can use OAuth 2.0. Microsoft also lists MCP and A2A, and says Agent ID is available for all Microsoft Entra customers.

sources.title: What is Microsoft Entra Agent ID

comparison.name: Skyfire KYAPay
comparison.verified: The individual or organization that controls the agent, and a payment the buyer committed when the token includes pay.
comparison.how: The buyer agent creates a signed JWT. A kya token carries identity claims. A pay token carries the amount the seller charges after delivery. A kya-pay token carries both. Buyers and sellers exchange the token directly.
comparison.issuer: Skyfire signs tokens created through its API. The JWT shape is also an IETF Internet-Draft.

comparison.name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
comparison.verified: That a Visa-approved agent sent the request. The protocol also describes signatures for consumer recognition and payment.
comparison.how: The agent adds an RFC 9421 HTTP message signature. The merchant rebuilds the signed material and checks it with the agent's public key.
comparison.issuer: Visa approves the agent. Its 2026-07-02 release says live merchant purchases used Trusted Agent Protocol and the Agent Directory.

sources.title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol getting started
Visa press release on live agentic transactions in Europe, 2026-07-02

comparison.name: Web Bot Auth
comparison.verified: Which automated client signed the HTTP request.
comparison.how: The client signs the request and publishes public keys in a directory. The Signature-Agent header points at that directory. Cloudflare's docs describe transitive trust from the site owner to the bot operator to the end user, and an experimental Forwarded header that names the operator.
comparison.issuer: The bot or agent operator hosts the keys. Cloudflare verifies bots that register a directory with it.

sources.title: IETF draft for HTTP Message Signatures for automated traffic

comparison.name: x401
comparison.verified: A credential the verifier requested, such as personhood, residency, membership, or organizational standing. Binding an agent identifier is optional. Payment stays on HTTP 402.
comparison.how: The server sends a PROOF-REQUEST header carrying an OpenID4VP request. The agent returns a PROOF-RESPONSE. The draft is version 0.2.0.
comparison.issuer: The verifier names trusted authorities in the request.

On 2026-09-30, Beltic said it emerged from stealth with a Know Your Agent platform that verifies an agent's identity, authority, and transactional legitimacy. The release says design partners get early access.
On 2026-09-30, Mastercard said it is working with Skyfire, which it calls a provider of Know Your Agent technology, so financial institutions and merchants can recognize trusted agents.

faqs.question: What is Know Your Agent?
faqs.answer: Know Your Agent is the check a merchant or service runs before it lets an agent transact. The check asks which agent is acting, on whose behalf, and with what authority.

definition: Signed token from Skyfire that binds an agent identity to a payment the buyer has committed. The seller charges the token after delivery.

HTTP 402 flow from Lightning Labs. The server returns a bearer token, recommended as a macaroon, and a Lightning invoice bound by the payment hash. The client pays, then presents the preimage so the server can check payment without a lookup.
Open HTTP 402 protocol, co-authored by Stripe and Tempo, so an agent can authorize payment for an API with a card or a stablecoin and receive a receipt.
Open protocol that connects an LLM application to external tools, resources, and prompts. Hosts, clients, and servers exchange JSON-RPC 2.0 messages.
More than one agent collaborating under a runtime. CrewAI pairs event driven Flows for control flow with Crews of role based agents that share a delegated task.
Protocol on A2A 1.0 that lets a personal agent sign its requests and act for a user only inside scopes that user approved with a brand.
A service that verifies a payment and settles it for the seller. In x402 the server asks the facilitator to verify, does the work, then asks the facilitator to settle.

source.title: Coinbase documentation for how x402 works

definition: Draft protocol for a company to publish how a personal agent may sign in and act on a person's account, using OAuth, OpenAPI, and MCP.
Software that returns a decision from policy code, separate from the application that enforces it. Open Policy Agent evaluates structured input against Rego policy.
A budget on model calls. LiteLLM Proxy enforces personal, team, and agent spend budgets when a database is connected.
A function an MCP server exposes for a model to execute. The MCP specification treats a tool as code execution and says hosts must get explicit user consent before invoking one.
Open commerce protocol so agents, businesses, and payment providers can negotiate checkout and identity linking over REST, MCP, or A2A.
Method for an automated client to sign HTTP requests so a site can verify which bot or agent sent them. The signature rules are still an IETF draft.
Open standard for per request HTTP payments. The server quotes a price, the client sends the request again with proof of payment, and a facilitator can verify and settle it.

source.title: Coinbase documentation for how x402 works
